subject: done权重宝石等级
body: 加权祈愿shop_pull_up根因=config.js GEM_FAMILIES step=0致gemEffectAt恒3,链路gemEffectAt-effectAt-shopPullPP-shopWeight-rollShopOffers消费侧直传无第二bug.改动:config shop_pull_up step0->3加3x等级注释,gems/game_core注释同步3x等级.验证:gemEffectAt Lv1-5=3/6/9/12/15,shopPullPP(3星)3/6/9/12/15 w103/106/109/112/115.减权镇守shop_pull_down同根因step=0,语义除3星门限外相同非文案差异一并修.改动:config shop_pull_down step0->3加注释.验证:Lv1-5 pp-3/-6/-9/-12/-15 w97/94/91/88/85,0/2星pp0 w100门限未动,同级双嵌pp0 w100抵消.消费侧rollShopOffers直吃shopWeight.审计:skills.audit=[] stage.audit=[] requireOK(config/gems/game_core/skills/stage/meta/tower/bonusStats).备注:工作区oval/star等未提交改动属他单范围本单仅动两权重step加同链路注释.
